entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. How may I assist you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. And I need to do it NOW. I’ve been on hold for ages.
I understand your frustration, sir/madam. I'll be happy to help you with your return. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's… hold on… it’s [customer provides email address].
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see here you purchased a VeloBand Pulse. What's the reason for the return?
Doesn't matter, does it? It’s not working for me. I just want to send it back. It’s a piece of junk. The heart rate monitor is wildly inaccurate.

I understand. While we strive for complete customer satisfaction, I'm sorry to hear the VeloBand Pulse isn't meeting your needs. Our standard return policy is 90 days for a full refund. Are you within that timeframe?
90 days? Well, yeah! I only got it like, two weeks ago. Maybe less. So just give me the instructions. I don't have time for this. I thought this smart watch would solve problems, not create them.

Okay, great. You are well within our return policy. I will email you a prepaid shipping label and instructions on how to pack and ship the VeloBand Pulse back to us. Once we receive it, we'll process your refund. Please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to appear in your account.
Finally! About time. Is there anything else? I have to go.
No, that's all. You'll receive the email within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, just send the label. This whole experience has been a nightmare.
I understand your frustration. We'll get that label right over to you. To clarify, you are returning the VeloBand Pulse, correct?
Yes! The VeloBand Pulse! That’s what I’ve been saying! Just send the damn label! I’m hanging up. You’re wasting my time.
Sir/Madam, please wait, I am happy to help, perhaps a manager can help if I am not able to…
Sir/Madam? I see the call has ended. I will still send the return label for the VeloBand Pulse as requested.
